status: Source audit only; native GPU MD barostat not enabled for PEG benchmarks
findings: Isotropic proposal is symmetric in L, but acceptance uses only N_objects log(V_new/V_old). Sampling the usual NPT measure dV requires an additional (2/3) log(V_new/V_old).
Molecular rescaling updates float positions. Mixed backend overrides atomic rescaling to refresh double positions, but has no analogous molecular override in the inspected source.
scope: Not applied to PEG_HMC: its CPU log-volume move and explicit synchronization use a separate path.
